description: go-wemix project Claude Code settings. Protects auto-generated/embedded files and surfaces Wemix-specific build/lint workflows.

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null)
if [[ -z "$path" ]]; then echo "$input"; exit 0; fi
if [[ "$path" == *"wemix/bind/gen_"*"_abi.go" ]]; then echo '[wemix] WARNING: wemix/bind/gen_*_abi.go is abigen-generated. Edit Solidity in wemix/governance-contract/contracts/ and regenerate via go generate.' >&2; fi
if [[ "$path" == *"core/wemix_genesis.go" ]]; then echo '[wemix] WARNING: core/wemix_genesis.go contains embedded mainnet/testnet genesis JSON. Modifying alters live network state — confirm intent.' >&2; fi
if [[ "$path" == *"/gen_"*".go" || "$path" == *"messages"*".pb.go" ]]; then echo '[wemix] WARNING: looks auto-generated (gencodec / protobuf / rlpgen). Regenerate via the source tool instead of editing.' >&2; fi
echo "$input"

#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
echo '[wemix] Pre-commit reminder: run `make lint && make test-short && make gwemix` if you have not already.' >&2
echo "$input"
